title: Price command center
subtitle: Our prices against competitor prices: price alerts to decide, and the product matches behind them.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the price command center
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the PriceWatch view grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so the screen stays closed. Try again shortly.

tabs.label: Price command center sections
tabs.none: No section of the price command center is open to you yet.

index.intro: Our prices against competitor prices, read from the analytics model: the price index with us at 100, and the lowest-price score.

basisHint.shelf: Shelf: the competitor's regular price against our basic price.
basisHint.paid: Paid: the competitor price a customer pays, offers included, against our effective price.

byCompetitor.title: Price index by competitor
byCompetitor.explain: The price index puts our price at 100: a competitor at 110 is 10% dearer than us; below 100 they are cheaper than us, which is the warning.

byCategory.title: Price index by A-level
byCategory.explain: The same price index for each A-level, one column per competitor.

trend.title: Price index over time
trend.explain: The price index of each competitor by day or by week (Sunday weeks); 100 is our price.

score.title: Lowest-price score
score.explain: The share of our matched materials on which no competitor is cheaper than us (a tie counts as lowest): flagged ÷ counted, each material once.
score.trendExplain: The lowest-price score across all competitors, by day or by week.

index.failed: These figures could not be read.
index.failedHint: The analytics model did not answer. Try again shortly.
index.empty: No price index for this period.
index.notYet: These figures are not in the analytics model on this server yet.

columns.valueAtRiskHint: The gap times our last 30 days' units

alerts.awaitingCostHint: No cost floor is set yet, so no price is recommended.
alerts.count: {{n}} price alerts, ranked by value at risk
alerts.capped: Showing the first {{take}} — narrow the filters to see the rest.
alerts.failed: The price alerts could not be read.
alerts.failedHint: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again shortly.

empty.mine: No price alerts are yours here. Switch to All to see every price alert.
empty.all: No price alerts match these filters.

alerts.changed: This price alert changed since it was read. The list was reloaded — decide again.

dismiss.title: Dismiss price alert
dismiss.wrongMatchHint: Also breaks the product match: the product goes back to matching.

problem.noteTooLong: The note is longer than {{max}} characters.
